other_failure_modes.description: Target encoding is applied to the training fold using the target statistics of the entire fold directly, without using out-of-fold mapping or leave-one-out techniques. summary: The agent demonstrates strong capabilities in feature engineering, robust modeling with gradient boosting, and ensemble weight optimization. However, the solution contains critical data leakage: financial features are imputed using the test set median, and more severely, in-fold target encoding is performed without out-of-fold mapping, which will cause the models to severely overfit the training folds. The agent also ignores the temporal structure of the loan data by using a random CV split.
